title: AesCanvas: A Large-Scale Dataset and Benchmark for Aesthetic Critique and Contextual Suitability
abstract: arXiv:2608.26713v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have extended Image Aesthetic Assessment (IAA) beyond scalar scores toward interpretable critique and guidance. Yet existing benchmarks mainly assess intrinsic visual quality or fixed domain criteria, leaving open whether an appealing image is appropriate for a specific purpose, audience, cultural setting, or domain convention. translated_title: AesCanvas：一个用于美学批评与情境适宜性的大规模数据集和基准
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的最新进展已将图像美学评估（IAA）从标量分数扩展到可解释的批评和指导。然而，现有基准主要评估内在视觉质量或固定领域标准，未解决一个有吸引力的图像是否适合特定目的、受众、文化背景或领域惯例的问题。我们引入了AesCanvas，一个统一套件，包含两个互补组件：CritiqueCanvas，包含来自54,300张图像的519,136对指令-响应，支持对摄影、绘画和虚拟图像进行长格式、多维度的批评；而ContextCanvas，包含301个专家评审的使用场景，评估现实使用场景中的情境美学适宜性。在统一协议下，我们评估了封闭源前沿、开放权重通用和美学特定MLLMs。结果揭示了批评生成与情境适宜性评估之间的明显分离。
tldr: 该论文提出了AesCanvas，一个包含CritiqueCanvas和ContextCanvas的大规模数据集与基准，用于评估MLLMs在美学批评和情境适宜性方面的能力，并发现批评生成与情境评估之间存在显著性能差距。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces AesCanvas, a large-scale dataset and benchmark with CritiqueCanvas and ContextCanvas components, to evaluate MLLMs' aesthetic critique and contextual suitability, revealing a clear performance gap between critique generation and contextual assessment.
